WildFocus

Turn your focus sessions into a pet collection. Every timer you complete earns you a new creature. Beat procrastination one Pomodoro at a time.

Screenshots

The problem

Why it exists

Most productivity apps treat focus like a chore. You set a timer, stare at a countdown, and feel guilty every time you break it. The discipline is all stick, no carrot.

Procrastination isn't a willpower failure — it's a motivation problem. When the reward for finishing a task is just… the next task, it's hard to start at all.

The approach

How it helps

WildFocus adds a tangible reward loop to the Pomodoro technique. Complete a focus session and you earn a random pet — common, rare, or legendary. Your collection grows with your focus streak.

It keeps everything on your device. No account required, no notifications from a server, no data leaving your phone. The gamification is lightweight and honest — it's there to help you build a habit, not to hook you into the app.

Key features

⏱️Focus TimerConfigurable Pomodoro-style sessions with custom durations and break reminders.
🐾Pet CollectionEarn a random pet after each session. Common, rare, epic, and legendary tiers.
🔥Daily StreaksTrack your daily focus habit and protect your streak with consistency.
🏆AchievementsUnlock milestones for total sessions, streak lengths, and rare pet discoveries.
🎯Daily ChallengesOptional daily goals that reward bonus tokens for completing extra sessions.
🔔Local NotificationsStreak reminders and session nudges, scheduled entirely on your device — no server involved.
🔒Private by DesignNo account, no analytics, no ads. All data stays on your device. Export / import any time.
🌗Light & Dark ModeFollows system theme or set it manually. Works comfortably at any time of day.
